method: Playwright MCP normal UI interactions with regression assertions. No forced clicks, disabled-field overrides, direct API submissions, or database manipulation. GPS and image uploads use declared local test fixtures.

browser_verified_fixes.proof: Regression failed when owner table showed only base price 5000. After fix it shows struck-through base 5000, client price 4000, and 20% off, matching card and summary.

browser_verified_fixes.cause: Programmatic On-Location selection did not trigger the map visibility handler.
browser_verified_fixes.proof: Regression failed with hidden venuePinMap before fix. After fix, map is visible, missing pin still blocks summary, emulated current location sets pin, and normal continuation opens summary.

Before fix, freelancer summary incorrectly said In-Studio Package. After fix, selected On-Location appears correctly; reopening summary leaves exactly one location, type, gallery, and duration label. Four-hour session is 09:00 to 13:00, total 4200, deposit 1260, balance 2940.
Regression reproduced hidden-field End time must be after the start time message. After fix, 22:00 plus four hours reports midnight overflow and keeps continuation disabled.

Regression failed because searchbox was absent. Added search uses existing server query filter, returns both Golden Hour members, retains badges, supports empty-result state, and Clear All restores providers and clears input.

Failing PHP regression demonstrated inconsistent spelling on save. Model now reuses earliest matching group spelling. Marco's existing lowercase group was saved through Save group name and became Golden Hour Collective, persisting after reload. No bulk data rewrite.

Regression reproduced open menu after Studios anchor click. After fix, 375-pixel viewport navigates to #studios, menu closes, aria-expanded becomes false, and page has no horizontal overflow. Handler also waits if collapse opening transition is still active.

Regression reproduced enabled Add original on published gallery 70. After fix, published original-upload controls are disabled. Same condition applied to photographer and freelancer templates; those roles still need direct browser retests. Server-side published-gallery rejection remains intact.

After actual on-site cancellation on booking 69, owner Assign Photographer shows Replacement Assignment and Cancelled on site, not Initial Assignment or Rejected this assignment. Cancelled photographer remains disabled. PHP lifecycle regression failed before fix and passed afterward.

Actual browser assignment 69 changed table badge to CONFIRMED, ON SITE, and CANCELLED without page reload. JavaScript regression verifies status class/text and removal of obsolete response deadline. Deadline removal added after browser run and needs a fresh transition for direct browser proof.
